concerns.text: T008 defines a Tier 2 fallback URL 'https://www.sdb.org/...' which is a semantic weakening of FR-001. FR-001 mandates data from 'PubChem or SDBS' (SDBS is riodb01.nite.go.jp). Using a non-existent domain as a fallback silently relaxes the requirement to fetch real data, violating Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and the 'Fail Loud' constraint.

T008.1 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and depends on T010 (which is also incomplete/broken). This creates a gap where SC-003 (Data Validity: 'all molecules... have valid RDKit-parsable SMILES') is not enforced before training. The task list fails to preserve the mandatory exclusion of invalid rows required by the spec.

T010 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and fails to deliver the 80/10/10 scaffold split required by FR-002 and Constitution Principle VII. Without this task, the 'Structural Leakage Prevention' constraint is silently dropped, allowing potential data leakage in the training pipeline.

T015b is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and fails to implement the hard 6-hour wall-clock limit required by SC-002. The task description mentions the logic but the incomplete status means the constraint is not preserved in the deliverable, risking pipeline execution beyond the constitutional budget.

T023a is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and fails to implement the ECFP collinearity check (Pearson r ≥ 0.9) required by FR-007. The task description mentions GNN latent similarity (T023b) but omits the baseline collinearity check, silently weakening the requirement to detect predictor collinearity.

T025 is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and fails to implement the masking of attribution weights for redundant subgraphs required by FR-007. Without this, the system cannot prevent 'spurious independent effect claims', violating the methodological robustness constraint.

T024 is marked incomplete (`- [~]`) and fails to implement GNNExplainer as required by FR-005. This drops the feature importance analysis requirement, leaving the interpretability constraint unfulfilled.

T026a is marked incomplete (`- [ ]`) and fails to implement the sensitivity analysis sweeping MAE thresholds required by FR-006. This drops the methodological robustness constraint regarding threshold justification.
